about_the_game:
Story

In the vast woodlands, the once-prosperous ancient kingdom now lies abandoned beneath the stony steps of Craftsman Ridge. Its former glory was devastated by a rampant plague. Now, as the world shifts and clans rise and fall, the perilous ruins welcome new tribes. Tempted by wealth, knowledge, and power, they descend into endless strife.

Here, you’ll encounter dangerous creatures, forge bonds with unlikely allies, hone your skills, and uncover forgotten knowledge. Seek your place among the warring clans, peel back the layers of the fallen kingdom’s history, and unravel the secrets of your own lineage.

Uncover the World

  • Explore the picturesque Beast Kingdom - from misty mountain peaks to tranquil lakes, forgotten ruins, and thriving settlements brimming with life.

  • Interconnected level design ensures exploration feels seamless, immersive, and endlessly rewarding.

  • Classic 2D hand-drawn animation brings characters to life with vibrant personalities.

  • Encounter diverse clans—choose to befriend them or bring their downfall.

  • A dynamic soundtrack shifts between grandeur and whimsy, capturing the unique tone of each region and culture.

  • Above all, uncover treasures and knowledge to strengthen yourself for the trials ahead.

Challenges & Achievements

  • Master precise swordplay and brushwork to face over 120 unique enemies and formidable bosses.

  • Discover skills with brush and ink to unlock powerful combat techniques, beat platforming challenges, and solve various puzzles.

  • Utilize mechanisms, tools, or even enemy remains to overcome obstacles.

  • Encounter clans shaped by diverse cultures - master their languages to unlock deeper truths about the world.

  • Collect and combine different Runewords to forge your own playstyle.

  • Make pivotal choices that will shape the fate of these clans and Lunar Capital.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit)
  • Processor: AMD Athlon X4 | Intel Core i5 4460
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 950 | AMD R7 370
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 | Intel i5 Skylake
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 970 | AMD RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: OTHERSIDE is a 2D, hand-drawn Metroidvania adventure featuring 'Mao' - a cat warrior awakened from slumber. Wield a sword and brush to explore a beast kingdom, encounter tribes, and uncover secrets.
supported_languages:
English*, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support
